newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila stocks end down as Redeco steals show.
newsitem.headline: Manila stocks end down as Redeco steals show.

text.p: * Main index bounces from day's low of 3,215.56
Manila stocks bounced at the close on Monday but not enough to pull the market into positive territory, traders said.
"Except for Redeco shares, market trading today is generally lacklustre with most issues either sideways or down, said Henry Ong, trader at Sapphire Securities.
The main index ended down by 2.93 points to 3,231.86, but off the day's low of 3,215.56
The Philippine Stock Exchange on Monday lifted its two-and-a-half year trading suspension on Redeco shares after the company complied with all the disclosure requirements.
Shares of the holding company ended at 10.25 pesos after hitting a day's high of 22 pesos. Some 97.9 million pesos worth of Redeco shares changed hands.
Traders said the eight-billion peso initial public offering of Equitable Banking Corp has sapped market liquidity. The bank is scheduled to be listed on April 3.

"Most investors also stayed in the sidelines due to uncertainties over the U.S. interest rates," said Allan Araullo, analyst at Regina Capital Development Corp. The U.S. Federal Reserve is set to meet on March 25 on whether it will increase rates.
Ong said he expected the market to mount a technical rally on Tuesday. "But I expect the rally to be short-lived. Expect weakness for the rest of the week," he added.
